deepNavy.job: Base ground. Home, Ponder, Mutter, app chrome.

emberGold.job: Rank, jewels, badges — earned only. Never ordinary chrome.

parchment.job: Ponder's writing surface. Warmth, not glare.

growthGreen.job: Streaks and progress — distinct from reward gold.

display.usage: Headlines, Soldier rank, celebrations. Never scripture.

body.usage: Scripture, questions, interface labels. Never decorated.

ageAdaptation.rule: Tokens never change. Only wording and Soldier illustration flex — never layout, colour, or interaction.
ageAdaptation.4-7: Very simple words. Everything read aloud. Soldier round, friendly, exaggerated.
ageAdaptation.8-11: Simple wording. Reading and listening both offered. Soldier proportioned, still warm.
ageAdaptation.12-17: Grown-up wording. Soldier heroic, painterly — no cartoon feel.

rules.paletteNarrowsWithFocus: Home is navy and gold. Ponder strips to near-monochrome parchment. Roar is the only screen allowed to go loud.
rules.scriptureNeverDecorated: No colour washes, no fancy framing. The one visual constant for ages 5 to 17.
rules.mutterCounter: Progress dots (filled dot = one repetition), never numeric-only. The row shows the whole journey to 20.
rules.soldierIllustrated: A character, not a logo — carries the age shift through art alone; UI stays age-agnostic.
